title: Browser Privacy Risk Calculator - Check Your Privacy Score
metaDescription: Calculate your browser privacy risk score based on settings, extensions, and browsing habits. Get personalized tips to improve your online privacy.
description: Assess your browser's privacy protection level by evaluating tracking protection, cookie settings, extensions, and browsing habits. Get a comprehensive privacy risk score and actionable recommendations to enhance your online security.

outputFields.label: Tracking Risk
outputFields.description: Likelihood of being tracked across websites

formula: const browserScores = { incognito: 25, brave: 20, firefox: 15, safari: 10, edge: 5, chrome: 0 }; const trackingScores = { custom: 25, strict: 20, standard: 10, none: 0 }; const cookieScores = { all: 20, most: 15, some: 10, none: 0 }; const incognitoScores = { always: 15, often: 12, sometimes: 8, rarely: 4, never: 0 }; const locationScores = { block: 10, ask: 5, always: 0 }; const browserScore = browserScores[browserType] || 0; const trackingScore = trackingScores[trackingProtection] || 0; const cookieScore = cookieScores[cookieSettings] || 0; const incognitoScore = incognitoScores[incognitoUsage] || 0; const extensionScore = Math.min(privacyExtensions * 3, 15); const loginPenalty = loginFrequency === 'frequent' ? -5 : loginFrequency === 'moderate' ? -2 : 0; const socialPenalty = socialMediaIntegration ? -5 : 0; const locationScore = locationScores[locationServices] || 0; const privacyScore = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, browserScore + trackingScore + cookieScore + incognitoScore + extensionScore + loginPenalty + socialPenalty + locationScore)); const trackingRisk = Math.max(0, 100 - privacyScore); const fingerprintingRisk = Math.max(10, 90 - privacyScore + (browserType === 'chrome' ? 10 : 0)); const riskLevel = privacyScore >= 80 ? 'A' : privacyScore >= 65 ? 'B' : privacyScore >= 50 ? 'C' : privacyScore >= 35 ? 'D' : 'F'; return { privacyScore: Math.round(privacyScore), riskLevel, trackingRisk: Math.round(trackingRisk), fingerprintingRisk: Math.round(fingerprintingRisk) };

educational.methodology: This calculator evaluates your browser privacy based on multiple factors: browser choice (privacy-focused browsers score higher), tracking protection settings, cookie policies, private browsing usage, privacy extensions, and risky behaviors like frequent logins and social media integration.
tips: Switch to privacy-focused browsers like Incognito Browser or Brave for better default protection
Enable strict tracking protection in your browser settings
Install reputable privacy extensions like uBlock Origin or Privacy Badger
Use private/incognito mode more frequently, especially for sensitive browsing
Block third-party cookies and limit location services access
Avoid using social media login buttons when possible
Regularly clear your browsing data and cookies
Consider using a VPN for additional privacy protection

interpretation.label: Excellent Privacy (A)
interpretation.description: Your browser provides strong privacy protection against most tracking and fingerprinting attempts.

interpretation.label: Good Privacy (B)
interpretation.description: Decent privacy protection, but there's room for improvement in some areas.

interpretation.label: Fair Privacy (C)
interpretation.description: Basic privacy protection. Consider upgrading your browser settings and tools.

interpretation.label: Poor Privacy (D)
interpretation.description: Limited privacy protection. Your browsing activity is likely being tracked extensively.

interpretation.label: Very Poor Privacy (F)
interpretation.description: Minimal privacy protection. Immediate action needed to protect your online privacy.
